words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: The opening ceremony was colorful and loud.
words.ex_cn: 开幕式色彩缤纷且热闹。
words.en: An opening ceremony is a formal event that marks the start of a significant occasion, such as the beginning of the Olympic Games, a conference, or a new building.

words.ex: The commencement ceremony will be held in the university auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 毕业典礼将在大学礼堂举行。
words.en: A commencement ceremony is a formal event held to celebrate the completion of academic studies by students, typically at the end of a school year.

words.ex: The convocation will start at nine in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 开学典礼将在早上九点开始。
words.en: A convocation is a large formal meeting, especially for the ceremony at a university at the end of a course of study.

words.ex: All new students must attend the orientation meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 所有新生必须参加周一的新生报到会。
words.en: An orientation meeting is a gathering designed to introduce new members, employees, or students to an organization or institution, providing them with essential information and helping them to adapt to their new environment.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.ex: He took a placement test to join the advanced class.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一次分班测试，以便进入高级班。
words.en: A placement test is a test usually given to a student entering an educational institution to determine the level of knowledge or proficiency in a particular subject or subjects.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr: phrase. 低于平均水平的；较差的
words.ex: His test score is below average.
words.ex_cn: 他的考试分数低于平均分。
words.en: If something is below average, it is worse than the average or usual standard.

words.tr: phrase. 大学校长；大学的最高行政负责人
words.ex: The university president gave a speech at the graduation.
words.ex_cn: 大学校长在毕业典礼上发表了演讲。
words.en: The head of a university, responsible for its administration and representation.

words.ex: The chancellor announced a new tax policy.
words.ex_cn: 大臣宣布了一项新的税收政策。
words.en: A chancellor is the head of the government in some countries, or a high-ranking official in a university or other institution.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: The dean gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 院长在毕业典礼上发表了演讲。
words.en: A dean is a senior official in a college or university, who is in charge of a faculty or department or a group of students.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: He is an associate professor at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的副教授。
words.en: An associate professor is a mid-level academic rank in universities and colleges, above assistant professor and below full professor.

words.ex: He is an assistant professor at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一名助理教授。
words.en: An assistant professor is a college or university teacher of the lowest rank, who is working towards becoming a full professor.

words.ex: She is the coordinator of the school event.
words.ex_cn: 她是学校活动的协调者。
words.en: A coordinator is someone whose job is to organize the various parts of an activity or the people involved in it so that it works efficiently.

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.ex: He asked his advisor for help with his project.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问寻求项目帮助。
words.en: An advisor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their financial affairs or about their education.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: The buildings are tall and old.
words.ex_cn: 这些建筑又高又旧。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.tr: phrase. 行政大楼；办公楼（用于管理事务的建筑物）
words.ex: The administration building is next to the library.
words.ex_cn: 行政楼在图书馆旁边。
words.en: A structure or office where official business, management, or governmental functions are conducted.

words.ex: The main building is where the classrooms are.
words.ex_cn: 主楼是教室所在的地方。
words.en: The principal or largest building of a complex, such as a university, hospital, or business.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: The house has a small annex for storage.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个用于存放物品的小附属物。
words.en: To annex means to take control of a country, region, etc., especially by force; to add an area or region to a country, state, etc. : to take control of (a territory or place).

words.ex: The students walk to the teaching building every morning.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每天早上步行去教学楼。
words.en: A building used for teaching and learning activities in educational institutions.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.ex: The students walk to the lecture hall for class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们走向礼堂上课。
words.en: A large room in a college or university where lectures are given.

words.ex: The assembly of the car took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的装配花了三天时间。
words.en: An assembly is a group of people gathered together for a particular purpose, such as a meeting or a legislative session. It can also refer to the process of fitting together the component parts of a machine or other object.

words.ex: The students use the computer lab for homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在计算机实验室做作业。
words.en: A room equipped with computers for students or employees to use for learning or work purposes.

words.ex: We eat lunch in the dining hall.
words.ex_cn: 我们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A dining hall is a large room in a institution where meals are served to a large number of people.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: He majored in arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修人文学科。
words.en: The arts are activities such as music, painting, literature, film, and dance, which people can take part in for enjoyment, or to create works which express important meanings or ideas.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢化学，因为它很有趣。
words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: He fixed the broken electronics with a small tool.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小工具修好了坏掉的电子器件。
words.en: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors and microchips, and with the behavior and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor, vacuum, or gas.

words.ex: He loves computer science and writes code every day.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱计算机科学，每天都写代码。
words.en: Computer science is the study of computers and computational systems. Unlike electrical and computer engineers, computer scientists deal mostly with software and software systems; this includes their theory, design, development, and application.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 电子工程（研究电子电路、设备和系统的设计与应用的工程学科）
words.ex: He is studying electronics engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习电子工程。
words.en: Electronics engineering is a discipline that integrates the principles of electrical engineering and computer science to develop electronic devices, circuits, and systems. It involves the design, testing, and production of electronic equipment used in various industries.

words.ex: He loves studying botany in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在花园里学习植物学。
words.en: Botany is the scientific study of plants.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.ex: He loves zoology and studies animals in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱动物学，研究野外的动物。
words.en: Zoology is the scientific study of animals.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.ex: He is learning oceanography at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习海洋学。
words.en: Oceanography is the scientific study of the sea.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: He works in medical science at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院从事医学科学工作。
words.en: Medical science is the science of diagnosing, treating, and preventing disease and damage to the body or mind.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.ex: He is studying linguistics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习语言学。
words.en: Linguistics is the scientific study of language and its structure, including the study of morphology, syntax, phonetics, and semantics.

words.ex: The teachers use new pedagogies to help students learn.
words.ex_cn: 老师们使用新的教学方法来帮助学生学习。
words.en: Pedagogies refer to the methods and practices of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.tr: v. 解释说明；“account”的现在分词； n. 会计；会计学；
words.ex: He is accounting for his absence.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解释他的缺席。
words.en: Accounting is the process of keeping financial accounts.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必不可少的； v. 需要；要求；“require”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Water is required for survival.
words.ex_cn: 水是生存所必需的。
words.en: Necessary according to the rules or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Math is a compulsory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A compulsory course is a subject that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.tr: adj. 选择性的；精挑细选的；
words.ex: He is selective about what he eats.
words.ex_cn: 他对吃的东西很挑剔。
words.en: If you are selective, you choose things carefully, for example, the things that you buy or do.

words.ex: She took an optional course in photography.
words.ex_cn: 她选了一门摄影的选修课。
words.en: An optional course is a class that students can choose to take as part of their studies, but it is not required for their degree.

words.tr: phrase. 选修课程；非必修的课程
words.ex: He takes an elective course in music.
words.ex_cn: 他选修了一门音乐课。
words.en: An elective course is a course that students can choose to take as part of their studies, which is not compulsory but allows them to explore subjects of interest outside their main field of study.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: The professor hosted a colloquium on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 教授举办了一场关于古代历史的研讨会。
words.en: A colloquium is an academic conference or seminar.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr: adj. 引导的；介绍的；开端的；
words.ex: This is an introductory book for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这是一本为初学者引导的书。
words.en: An introductory remark, event, or action is one that comes at the beginning of something, often in order to explain or introduce it.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.ex: He attends class every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上课。
words.en: To be present at a class or lecture as part of a course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 缺课；旷课；错过上课
words.ex: He missed class because he was sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病而没上课。
words.en: To fail to attend a class or lecture.

words.ex: He skipped class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天逃课了。
words.en: To intentionally not attend a class or school without permission.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 指定教材；必修课本
words.ex: The teacher said the required textbook is on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 老师说所需的教科书在书架上。
words.en: A textbook that is mandatory for a particular course or subject.

words.ex: His attendance at the meeting was mandatory.
words.ex_cn: 他必须出席这次会议。
words.en: The act of being present at a place or event.

words.tr: phrase. 等级制度；评分系统；分级体系
words.ex: The school uses a simple grading system to evaluate students.
words.ex_cn: 学校使用一个简单的等级制度来评估学生。
words.en: A grading system is a method used to assess and categorize students' academic performance based on predefined criteria.

words.ex: He improves his grade with good class participation.
words.ex_cn: 他通过积极的课堂参与提高成绩。
words.en: Active involvement in classroom discussions and activities, often assessed for grading.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.tr: phrase. 课程指南；课程指导方针
words.ex: The teacher gave us the course guideline on the first day.
words.ex_cn: 老师在第一天给了我们课程指南。
words.en: A course guideline is a document that provides information and instructions about a particular course, including its objectives, content, and requirements.

words.ex: He got an exemption from paying the fee.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了免交费用的豁免。
words.en: An exemption is an official permission not to do something or not to pay something that you would normally have to do or pay.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.ex: The student needs the professor's signature on the form.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要教授在表格上签名。
words.en: The handwritten name of a university teacher, used to authorize documents.

words.tr: phrase. 课程限制；指学校对某门课程注册人数或学分的上限规定
words.ex: The course cap is 30 students.
words.ex_cn: 这门课的上限是30名学生。
words.en: A limit set on the number of students that can enroll in a particular course.

words.tr: n. 开口；开幕；空缺职位；“opening”的复数
words.ex: The holes in the wall are small openings.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的洞是小开口。
words.en: Openings refer to the act of making or becoming open, or the beginning of something. It can also refer to opportunities or positions that are available.

words.tr: v. 做（某个动作）；接受；带领；花费；拿；乘坐；
words.ex: He takes a deep breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸一口气。
words.en: To lay hold of (something) with one's hands; reach for and hold.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.tr: phrase. 延迟注册；逾期登记（指学校或机构在常规注册期结束后仍允许学生或参与者补注册的手续或时间段）
words.ex: He missed the early registration, so he did late registration.
words.ex_cn: 他错过了早期注册，所以进行了迟注册。
words.en: The process of signing up or enrolling after the official deadline has passed.

words.ex: He completed the deregistration before leaving the school.
words.ex_cn: 他离开学校前完成了注销手续。
words.en: The act of removing or canceling the registration of something.

words.ex: The professor teaches physics at the university.
words.ex_cn: 这位教授在大学教物理。
words.en: A professor is a senior teacher in a college or university.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: He is a teaching assistant for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他是数学课的助教。
words.en: A teaching assistant is a person who helps a teacher in a classroom, often by providing support to students or helping with the preparation of lessons.

words.ex: Ta John helps students with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 助教约翰帮助学生做作业。
words.en: Used to express thanks.

words.tr: phrase. 研究助理；科研助理
words.ex: He works as a research assistant at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里担任研究助理。
words.en: A research assistant is a person employed to help with research, typically in a university or scientific institution.

words.ex: Radium (Ra) is a radioactive element.
words.ex_cn: 镭（Ra）是一种放射性元素。
words.en: A non-standard abbreviation for 'radium', a chemical element (symbol Ra), or 'right angle' in geometry.

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.ex: He is an adviser to the government.
words.ex_cn: 他是政府的顾问。
words.en: An adviser is a person who gives advice, especially someone who knows a lot about a particular subject.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: The teacher helps students with math.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person whose job is to teach in a school or college.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.tr: phrase. 学生的导师；学业顾问
words.ex: The student's advisor helped him choose his classes.
words.ex_cn: 学生的导师帮助他选择了课程。
words.en: A university teacher who guides a student's academic work.

words.ex: He is a physicist who studies stars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位研究恒星的物理学家。
words.en: A physicist is a scientist who specializes in the field of physics, which is the study of matter, energy, and the fundamental forces of nature.

words.ex: He is a famous mathematician.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的数学家。
words.en: A mathematician is a person who is an expert in mathematics, a field that uses numbers, formulas, and logical reasoning to solve problems.

words.ex: The chemist discovered a new element.
words.ex_cn: 这位化学家发现了一种新元素。
words.en: A chemist is a scientist who specializes in chemistry, or in some contexts, a person who is qualified to prepare and dispense drugs and medicines.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.ex: The statistician analyzed the survey data.
words.ex_cn: 这位统计学家分析了调查数据。
words.en: A statistician is a person who specializes in the study and interpretation of numerical data, especially in order to make predictions or inferences about a population or a process.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: He finished his coursework last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了他的课程作业。
words.en: Coursework refers to the work that students do during a course of study, which is often assessed as part of their final grade.

words.tr: n. 学校作业；课堂作业；
words.ex: He finished his schoolwork before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了学校作业。
words.en: Schoolwork refers to the work that students are required to do as part of their studies at school.

words.tr: n. 研究；学习；“study”的复数； v. 研究；学习；
words.ex: His studies show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的研究显示睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The act of learning or acquiring knowledge, especially from books or through systematic investigation.

words.ex: He wrote a lab report after the science experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学实验后写了一份实验报告。
words.en: A lab report is a document that describes and analyzes laboratory experiments conducted in a scientific context. It typically includes the purpose of the experiment, the methods used, the results obtained, and the conclusions drawn.

words.tr: phrase. 读书报告；对所读书籍的内容、主题和观点进行总结和分析的书面作业
words.ex: He wrote a book report about a detective story.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于侦探故事的读书报告。
words.en: A written assignment summarizing and analyzing a book, typically for educational purposes.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 学期论文；学期报告（通常为大学课程结束时提交的学术论文）
words.ex: He wrote a term paper about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学期论文。
words.en: A term paper is a research paper written by students over an academic term, accounting for a large part of a grade.

words.tr: phrase. 研究论文；学术论文
words.ex: He wrote a research paper about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的研究论文。
words.en: A research paper is a piece of academic writing that provides analysis, interpretation, and argument based on in-depth independent research.

words.ex: His thesis is that exercise improves memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点是锻炼能改善记忆力。
words.en: A thesis is a long piece of writing based on your own ideas and research that you do as part of a university degree, especially a higher degree such as a PhD.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr: phrase. 社会调查；社会研究
words.ex: He did a social investigation about poverty.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一项关于贫困的社会调查。
words.en: Systematic study of social structures, behaviors, and issues within communities or groups.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: The scientist collects data every day.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天收集数据。
words.en: To gather information or statistics systematically for analysis.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.tr: phrase. 缩小范围；精简；使变窄
words.ex: He tried to narrow down the list of options.
words.ex_cn: 他试图缩小选项的范围。
words.en: To reduce the number of possibilities or choices.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: He uses critical thinking to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用批判性思维解决问题。
words.en: Critical thinking is the objective analysis and evaluation of an issue in order to form a judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏你自己的想法；缺少个人主见
words.ex: He just repeats what others say because he lacks your own ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他只是重复别人说的话，因为他缺乏你自己的想法。
words.en: To not have or be without your own original thoughts or concepts.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.tr: phrase. 到期日；截止日期；预产期
words.ex: The due date for the homework is Friday.
words.ex_cn: 作业的截止日期是星期五。
words.en: The date by which something is expected to happen or be completed.

words.tr: phrase. 适当的时候；预定的时间；到期的时间
words.ex: He will tell you the truth in due time.
words.ex_cn: 他会在适当的时候告诉你真相。
words.en: The appropriate or expected time for something to happen or be done.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.ex: He made a roadmap to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一份学习英语的路线图。
words.en: A roadmap is a plan or strategy intended to achieve a particular goal.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He was punished for plagiarism in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他因论文剽窃而受到惩罚。
words.en: Plagiarism is the practice of using or copying someone else's idea or work and pretending that you thought of it or created it.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: He had to rewrite his essay after the teacher gave feedback.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师给出反馈后不得不重写他的作文。
words.en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it or because circumstances have changed.

words.tr: phrase. 最终草案；最后定稿
words.ex: He wrote the final draft yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天写了最终稿。
words.en: The last version of a document or piece of writing that is ready to be published or submitted.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.ex: He made eye contact with the teacher during the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时与老师进行了眼神交流。
words.en: The act of looking directly into someone's eyes as a means of communication or to express interest.

words.ex: His intonation made the sentence sound friendly.
words.ex_cn: 他的语调让这句话听起来很友好。
words.en: Intonation is the way the voice rises and falls in speech, especially the pitch pattern in a sentence.

words.ex: He studied hard for the mid-term exam.
words.ex_cn: 他为期中考试努力学习。
words.en: An examination taken in the middle of an academic term.

words.ex: Students are preparing for their final exams.
words.ex_cn: 学生们正在为期末考试做准备。
words.en: The final exams are the last set of examinations in a course of study, typically determining a student's grade in the course.

words.ex: He is preparing for finals next week.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为下周的期末考试做准备。
words.en: The last and most important game, race, or set of games in a competition or a series of exams taken at the end of a school or college course.

words.tr: phrase. 累积的最终考试；指涵盖整个课程内容的期末考试
words.ex: The cumulative final covers all the topics from the semester.
words.ex_cn: 期末考试涵盖本学期的所有内容。
words.en: Relating to or denoting the total amount of something when it is all added together.

words.tr: phrase. 带回家完成的考试；开卷笔试（通常允许学生在规定时间内在家作答并提交）
words.ex: He finished his take-home exam last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚完成了他的带回家考试。
words.en: An examination that students complete at home rather than in a classroom setting.

words.tr: phrase. 开卷考试（允许查阅教材或笔记的考试）
words.ex: He took an open-book exam in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上参加了一次开卷考试。
words.en: An open-book exam is a test where students are allowed to use textbooks, notes, and other materials. It assesses the ability to apply knowledge rather than memorize information.

words.tr: phrase. 主观的测试；依赖个人判断或感受的测验
words.ex: The teacher gave a subjective test to check our opinions.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个主观测试来检查我们的观点。
words.en: A subjective test is an assessment method that relies on the personal judgment of the examiner rather than objective criteria.

words.tr: phrase. 客观测验；客观性测试（答案明确、评分不受主观因素影响的考试，如选择题、判断题等）
words.ex: The students took an objective test with multiple-choice questions.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了一次有多个选择题的客观测验。
words.en: An objective test is a test that has right or wrong answers and can be scored without the need for interpretation.

words.tr: phrase. 突击测验；随堂小考
words.ex: The teacher gave us a pop quiz today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天给我们做了一次突然小测验。
words.en: A short, unannounced test to assess recent learning.

words.tr: phrase. 蓝皮书（官方报告或手册）
words.ex: The government released a blue book about education reform.
words.ex_cn: 政府发布了一份关于教育改革的蓝皮书。
words.en: A blue book is an official report or document published by a government or organization, often containing detailed information on a specific topic.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: The boss gave a positive appraisal of his work.
words.ex_cn: 老板对他的工作给予了积极的评估。
words.en: An appraisal is a judgement or assessment of the value, nature, or quality of something or someone.

words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.ex: He will resit the math exam next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将重考数学考试。
words.en: If someone resits an examination, they take it again, usually because they failed it the first time.

words.tr:
v. 重取；重新摄制；重考
n. 重取；重新摄制；重考
words.ex: He will retake the math test next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将重考数学考试。
words.en: To take something again, especially a photograph or a film scene, or to take control of a place again after losing it.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.tr:
n. 记号；分数；痕迹；
v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；
words.ex: He put a mark on the map to show the place.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图上做了一个记号来表示那个地方。
words.en: A mark is a small area or spot on a surface which is different in colour or texture from the area around it. If you mark something, you make a mark on it in order to identify it or to give information about it.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.tr: phrase. 完美的成绩；满分等级
words.ex: He got a perfect grade on his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了满分。
words.en: A top score or mark, indicating the highest level of achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 低等级的；低质量的；轻度的；低级别的
words.ex: The student got a low grade on the test.
words.ex_cn: 这个学生考试成绩很低。
words.en: Of inferior quality or standard.

words.ex: He got a high mark in math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: A high mark refers to a high score or a high standard, often used to denote excellence or superior performance.

words.tr: phrase. 及格分数；通过课程的最低成绩
words.ex: He got a passing grade on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了及格分。
words.en: A passing grade is the minimum grade required to pass an exam or a course.

words.ex: He received a failing grade in math this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期数学得了不及格分数。
words.en: A failing grade is a mark given to a student who has not met the minimum requirements to pass a course or exam.

words.ex: He got full marks in the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了满分。
words.en: The highest possible score or grade that can be achieved in a test or examination.

words.ex: He got straight A's in all his subjects this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期所有科目都得了直A。
words.en: Grades of A in all subjects.

words.tr: phrase. （非正式）指某人成绩优异，尤指在学校考试中获得全是A和B的好成绩；也可引申为表现非常出色
words.ex: He was all a's and b's on his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学考试得了全A。
words.en: To be in a state of complete harmony or agreement; to have everything going perfectly.

words.ex: He got a B plus in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上得了B+。
words.en: A grade that is slightly higher than a B, often used in academic grading systems.

words.ex: The temperature is a minus five degrees.
words.ex_cn: 温度是零下五度。
words.en: A minus is a grade or mark that is slightly below the standard of an A, or it can refer to the mathematical symbol for subtraction or a negative value.

words.w: pass the exam with flying colors
words.tr: phrase. 以优异成绩通过考试
words.ex: He studied hard and passed the exam with flying colors.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: To pass an exam with flying colors means to pass it with a very high score or with great success.

words.tr: 短语动词. 以优异成绩毕业；荣誉毕业
words.ex: He will graduate with honors this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天将以优异成绩毕业。
words.en: To complete a course of study at a college or university with a high level of achievement.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.tr:
adj. 周期的；定期的
n. 期刊
words.ex: The plant has a periodical blooming cycle.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物有周期性的开花周期。
words.en: A periodical is a magazine, especially one that is published regularly, or something that happens at regular intervals.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.tr: phrase. 图书目录；书籍的清单或列表
words.ex: He looked up the book catalogue to find the novel.
words.ex_cn: 他查阅了图书目录来寻找那本小说。
words.en: A book catalogue is a list of books, typically arranged in a systematic order, often with details such as author, title, and publication date.

words.tr: phrase. 分类目录；经过分类整理的目录清单
words.ex: The library has a classified catalogue for books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有一本分类的图书目录。
words.en: A classified catalogue is a system of organizing materials, such as books or documents, into categories based on their subject matter.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr: phrase. 标题索引；书名索引
words.ex: The book has a title index at the back.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的背面有一个标题索引。
words.en: An alphabetical list of titles in a collection, used to locate specific works.

words.tr: phrase. 按字母顺序排列的索引；字母索引
words.ex: The book includes an alphabetic index to help readers find topics quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包含一个字母索引，以帮助读者快速找到主题。
words.en: An alphabetic index is a list of items arranged in the order of the alphabet, typically found at the end of a book or document to help locate information quickly.

words.ex: He returned the book at the circulation desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借还书台归还了这本书。
words.en: The circulation desk is the place in a library where you can borrow and return books.

words.tr: phrase. 保留书籍；预约图书（图书馆中为特定读者预留、暂不外借的藏书）
words.ex: The reserved books are on the shelf near the librarian.
words.ex_cn: 预留的书在图书管理员附近的架子上。
words.en: Books that have been set aside for a specific person or purpose.

words.ex: He uses his library card to borrow books.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的借书证借书。
words.en: A library card is a card issued by a library to individuals, entitling them to borrow books and other materials.

words.tr: phrase. 逾期罚款；因逾期未还（书、账单等）而被收取的罚金
words.ex: He paid the overdue fine at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆支付了逾期罚款。
words.en: A charge imposed for returning a borrowed item, such as a library book, after its due date.

words.tr: phrase. 期刊阅览室；报刊阅览室
words.ex: He reads newspapers in the periodical reading room.
words.ex_cn: 他在期刊阅览室读报纸。
words.en: A room in a library or other institution where periodicals are kept and can be read.

words.tr: phrase. 在线期刊；网络日志
words.ex: She decided to keep an online journal to document her travels.
words.ex_cn: 她决定保持一个在线期刊来记录她的旅行。
words.en: An online journal is a periodical publication that is available on the internet, often containing articles, research papers, and other written content.

words.ex: He recorded the game on a video tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把比赛录在录像带上。
words.en: A video tape is a magnetic tape used for recording visual images and sound.

words.tr: phrase. 过期的期刊；往期杂志
words.ex: He bought a back issue of the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本往期的杂志。
words.en: A back issue refers to a past edition of a magazine, journal, or other periodical that is no longer the current issue.

words.ex: The library has the latest current issue of the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有这本杂志的最新现期刊物。
words.en: The most recent edition of a newspaper, magazine, or journal.

words.ex: The library keeps old newspapers in an archive.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧报纸保存在档案馆里。
words.en: A collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.

words.tr: n. 纪实文学；非小说类文学作品
words.ex: He reads non-fiction books about history.
words.ex_cn: 他读关于历史的非小说类书籍。
words.en: Writing based on facts, real events, and actual people, rather than imagination.

words.ex: He loves reading science-fiction books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Science fiction is a genre of speculative fiction that typically deals with imaginative and futuristic concepts such as advanced science and technology, space exploration, time travel, parallel universes, and extraterrestrial life.

words.ex: The copier is broken, so we can't make copies.
words.ex_cn: 复印机坏了，所以我们不能复印了。
words.en: A copier is a machine that makes paper copies of documents and other visual images quickly and cheaply.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆馆际互借服务
words.ex: The library offers an interlibrary service to borrow books from other libraries.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆提供馆际服务，可以从其他图书馆借书。
words.en: A service allowing libraries to borrow materials from other libraries on behalf of their patrons.

words.ex: He asked for help at the information desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在信息台寻求帮助。
words.en: A place in a public building where you can go to get information.

words.ex: He returned the book at the delivery desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借书台还了书。
words.en: A place in a building where you can collect or arrange for the delivery of items.

words.ex: He put the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A shelf is a flat piece of wood, metal, or glass which is attached to a wall or to the sides of a cupboard. Shelves are used for keeping things on.

words.ex: He went to the photocopy room to make a copy of his paper.
words.ex_cn: 他去复印室复印了他的论文。
words.en: A room equipped with photocopiers for making copies of documents.

words.tr: phrase. 返回区域；回收区；退货区
words.ex: The return area is near the exit door.
words.ex_cn: 返回区域在出口门附近。
words.en: The designated section in a library or store where customers can bring back borrowed or purchased items.

words.tr: phrase. 学生储物柜；供学生存放物品的带锁小柜
words.ex: The students locker is broken.
words.ex_cn: 学生的储物柜坏了。
words.en: A locker assigned to a student for storing personal belongings at school.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书区；参考资料部分；文献引用部分
words.ex: He checked the reference section for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考文献区查找那本书。
words.en: The part of a library where reference materials, such as encyclopedias and dictionaries, are kept for in-library use only.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr: phrase. 备择假设（统计学中与原假设相对的假设，通常表示研究者希望证实的效应或差异）
words.ex: The scientist proposed an alternative hypothesis to explain the results.
words.ex_cn: 科学家提出了一个替代假设来解释这些结果。
words.en: In statistics, the alternative hypothesis is a statement that suggests a potential outcome that the researcher expects to find, which is different from the null hypothesis.

words.ex: The scientist tests the null hypothesis with data.
words.ex_cn: 科学家用数据检验零假设。
words.en: In statistics, the null hypothesis is a general statement or default position that there is no relationship between two measured phenomena.

words.ex: The scientist collects data every day.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天收集数据。
words.en: To gather information or statistics systematically for analysis.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: The phone has a simple interface.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个简单的界面。
words.en: An interface is a point where two systems, subjects, organizations, etc. meet and interact.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: Scientists analyze data to understand climate change.
words.ex_cn: 科学家分析数据以了解气候变化。
words.en: To examine and interpret information or statistics systematically.

words.tr: phrase. 互联网数据；通过互联网传输或存储的数据
words.ex: He uses internet data to watch videos.
words.ex_cn: 他用互联网数据看视频。
words.en: Information transmitted or stored by computers connected to a global network.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.tr: adj. 分析的；善于分析的；
words.ex: He uses analytical skills to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用分析能力解决数学问题。
words.en: An analytical way of doing something involves the use of logical reasoning.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: The treatment group took the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 治疗组服用了新药。
words.en: In an experiment, the treatment group is the group that receives the specific intervention or treatment being studied.

words.ex: The non-treatment group did not receive any medicine.
words.ex_cn: 非治疗组没有接受任何药物。
words.en: The act or process of not providing medical care or treatment.

words.ex: The control group did not take any medicine.
words.ex_cn: 对照组没有服用任何药物。
words.en: In an experiment, a control group is a group of subjects or conditions that is used as a standard of comparison to verify the result of the experiment.

chapters.name: 校内工作，课外活动及寻找经济援助

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a letter of reference.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师写一封推荐信。
words.en: A letter of reference is a letter in which someone who knows you well writes about your character and abilities, usually for the purpose of helping you get a job or a place at a college or university.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.tr: phrase. 有益于未来职业；对将来的工作发展有帮助
words.ex: Learning English can benefit your future career.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语可以对你的未来职业有帮助。
words.en: To be advantageous or helpful to one's future professional development.

words.tr: phrase. 现场调查研究；田野调查
words.ex: He did field research in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他在丛林中进行了实地研究。
words.en: Field research refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting. The approaches and methods used in field research vary across disciplines but generally involve direct observation, interviews, and participation in the activities of the community being studied.

words.ex: He collects data for papers every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周为论文收集数据。
words.en: To gather information or facts for the purpose of writing academic articles or research.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.ex: She hires a babysitter to look after her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她请了一个保姆来照看她的宝宝。
words.en: A babysitter is someone who looks after children while their parents are out.

words.ex: He works at the library every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末在图书馆工作。
words.en: To perform tasks or duties in a library setting.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的； v. 取得资格；“qualify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a qualified teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有资格的老师。
words.en: Having the necessary qualifications for a particular job or task.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.tr: phrase. 财政援助；经济资助
words.ex: He got financial aid to pay for his books.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了经济援助来支付书本费用。
words.en: Financial aid refers to funding intended to help students pay education expenses including tuition, books, and living costs for study at post-secondary educational institutions.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；情谊；团体；联谊会；研究生奖学金
words.ex: They formed a fellowship to work on the project together.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了伙伴关系一起来做这个项目。
words.en: A fellowship is a group of people who join together for a common purpose or interest, or a financial grant given to a scholar to allow them to study or research at an advanced level.

words.tr: phrase. 教学助理职位；助教奖学金（通常指研究生担任教学辅助工作以换取学费减免或津贴）
words.ex: He got a teaching assistantship to pay for his tuition.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一个助教职位来支付学费。
words.en: A teaching assistantship is a position in which a student assists a professor in teaching, often in exchange for financial support or academic credit.

words.tr: phrase. 研究助理奖学金；研究助理职位（通常指研究生在导师指导下参与科研项目并获得学费减免及生活津贴的资助形式）
words.ex: He got a research assistantship to help with the science project.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了研究助理奖学金来协助科学项目。
words.en: A position in which a person assists in research, typically at a university or research institution, often providing financial support and academic benefits.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.tr: 按需求评定的（美国大学提供奖学金的一种评定方式）
words.ex: He gets need-based help from the school.
words.ex_cn: 他从学校获得基于需求的帮助。
words.en: Relating to or based on financial need, especially for grants or aid.

words.tr: adj. 基于优点的，基于功绩的
words.ex: Scholarships are merit-based.
words.ex_cn: 奖学金是基于成绩的。
words.en: Based on merit or achievement rather than other factors such as seniority or connections.

words.ex: The student union organized a free concert on campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生会在学校组织了一场免费音乐会。
words.en: The student union is an organization found in many colleges, universities, and high schools. In higher education, the student union is often accorded its own building on the campus, dedicated to social, organizational activities, representation, and academic support of the membership.

words.ex: He joins a book clubs after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后加入了一个读书俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick with a thick end, used as a weapon.

words.tr: n. 会员资格；全体会员；
words.ex: He paid $50 to get membership of the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了50美元以获得健身房的会员资格。
words.en: Membership is the state of being a member of a group or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 职业服务；就业辅导服务（通常指学校或机构为帮助学生或求职者规划职业、寻找工作而提供的支持服务）
words.ex: He visited the career service office to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他去职业服务办公室找工作。
words.en: A service provided by an institution, especially an educational institution, to help people plan their careers and find jobs.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: He lives in the residence hall with his roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和室友住在学生宿舍里。
words.en: A residence hall is a building where students live, typically on a university campus.

words.ex: They booked a hotel suite for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间酒店套房。
words.en: A set of rooms designated for use together, especially in a hotel; a set of musical compositions designed to be performed in a sequence.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.tr: n. 家庭寄宿；住在当地人家中
words.ex: She decided to do a home-stay to improve her language skills.
words.ex_cn: 她决定进行家庭寄宿以提高她的语言技能。
words.en: A home-stay is a type of accommodation where a visitor stays in a local family's home, often to experience the local culture and improve language skills.

words.ex: My roommate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A roommate is a person with whom one shares a room or rooms, especially in a college or university dormitory or a shared apartment.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.ex: The landlady gives us the keys every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 女房东每周一给我们钥匙。
words.en: A woman who rents out land, a building, or accommodation.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: We had dinner on the patio.
words.ex_cn: 我们在庭院里吃了晚饭。
words.en: A patio is an outdoor space generally used for dining or recreation that adjoins a residence and is typically paved.

words.ex: The sliding door opens easily with a push.
words.ex_cn: 这个滑动门轻轻一推就开了。
words.en: A sliding door is a type of door which opens horizontally by sliding, usually parallel to a wall.

words.ex: He booked a single room for the night.
words.ex_cn: 他预订了一个单人房间过夜。
words.en: A single room is a hotel room designed for one person, containing one single bed.

words.tr: phrase. 带两张单人床的双人房
words.ex: We booked a twin room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room with two single beds, typically for two people.

words.ex: They live in a two-bedroom apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一间两居室公寓里。
words.en: A two-bedroom apartment is a flat that has two bedrooms, typically used for living purposes.

words.ex: I lost my house key yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天弄丢了我家的钥匙。
words.en: A house key is a key that is used to unlock the door of a house.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.tr: phrase. 床上用品；被单和枕套
words.ex: She bought new bed linen for her bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 她为卧室买了新的床单被套。
words.en: Sheets, pillowcases, and other items used on a bed.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: He bought a new mattress for his bed.
words.ex_cn: 他为床买了一个新床垫。
words.en: A mattress is a large, flat pad that is placed on a bed to make it comfortable to sleep on.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: She makes a quilt for her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她为宝宝做了一床被子。
words.en: A quilt is a bed cover made by sewing layers of fabric together, often with a layer of padding in between, to provide warmth.

words.ex: He bought a new electric appliance for the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他为厨房买了一件新的电器。
words.en: An electric appliance is a device or piece of equipment that uses electricity to perform a particular function, such as cooking, cleaning, or entertainment.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The heater keeps the room warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个加热器在冬天让房间保持温暖。
words.en: A device used to generate heat for warming a space or water.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.tr: phrase. 加热装置；取暖设备
words.ex: The heating unit broke down last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天，加热装置坏了。
words.en: A heating unit is a device or system that provides heat to a space or to a process.

words.ex: He turned on the air conditioner to cool the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了空调来让房间凉快。
words.en: An air conditioner is a machine that keeps the air in a building cool and dry.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.ex: He heats food in a microwave oven.
words.ex_cn: 他用微波炉加热食物。
words.en: A microwave oven is an oven that uses microwaves to cook or heat food.

words.ex: She put the clothes in the washer.
words.ex_cn: 她把衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: A washer is a machine that washes clothes, or a person whose job is to wash clothes, or a flat ring made of metal, rubber, or plastic that is used to make a joint tight.

words.tr: n. 烘干机； adj. “dry”的比较级；
words.ex: I put my clothes in the dryer after washing.
words.ex_cn: 我洗完衣服后把它们放进烘干机。
words.en: A dryer is a machine that dries things, especially clothes, by using hot air.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon, a common utensil.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起了一把勺子，一种常见的餐具。
words.en: An utensil is a tool that you use in your home, especially in the kitchen, for example, a knife, fork, or spoon.

words.ex: She bought a new kitchen utensil to stir soup.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一个新的厨房用具来搅拌汤。
words.en: A kitchen utensil is a small hand-held tool used for food preparation.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: She put the dirty plates into the dishwasher.
words.ex_cn: 她把脏盘子放进洗碗机里。
words.en: A dishwasher is a machine that washes dirty dishes automatically.

words.ex: She uses the washing machine every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都用洗衣机。
words.en: A washing machine is a machine that washes clothes, sheets, and other items.

words.ex: The hot-water heater broke last night.
words.ex_cn: 热水加热器昨晚坏了。
words.en: An appliance that heats water for domestic use.

words.ex: He poured coffee from the coffeepot.
words.ex_cn: 他从咖啡壶里倒出咖啡。
words.en: A coffeepot is a pot in which coffee is brewed or served.

words.ex: He put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A refrigerator is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: She put the ice cream in the freezer.
words.ex_cn: 她把冰淇淋放进冷冻柜里。
words.en: A freezer is a device that is used to store food at very low temperatures in order to preserve it.

words.ex: He uses a vacuum cleaner to clean the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他用吸尘器打扫地板。
words.en: A vacuum cleaner is an electrical appliance that cleans floors and other surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.tr: phrase. 磁带播放器；录音机
words.ex: He listens to music on a tape player.
words.ex_cn: 他用磁带播放器听音乐。
words.en: A tape player is a device that plays sound recordings on magnetic tape.

words.tr: phrase. 光盘播放器；CD 播放机
words.ex: He plays music on his CD player.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的CD播放器听音乐。
words.en: A device that plays audio CDs.

words.ex: He goes to the laundromat every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六去自助洗衣店。
words.en: A laundromat is a place where you pay to use machines that wash and dry clothes.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: He put his books on the bookshelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在书架上。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: The bookcase is full of storybooks.
words.ex_cn: 书架上放满了故事书。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He sat on the couch and watched TV.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在沙发上看电视。
words.en: A couch is a long, comfortable seat for two or more people to sit on. It is also used to refer to a piece of furniture designed for lying down or sleeping.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.ex: The dresser helped the actress put on makeup for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 化妆师帮助女演员为电影化妆。
words.en: A dresser is a piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes, or a person who dresses in a particular way.

words.ex: The weather bureau issued a storm warning.
words.ex_cn: 气象局发布了风暴预警。
words.en: A bureau is an office, organization, or government department that collects and distributes information.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫放在壁橱里。
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

words.tr: phrase. 储物墙；用于收纳和储藏物品的墙面结构
words.ex: The storage wall holds all the books.
words.ex_cn: 这个储物墙放着所有的书。
words.en: A storage wall is a wall designed with built-in storage units, such as shelves, cabinets, or compartments, to organize and store items efficiently.

words.ex: He sat on the rug near the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在壁炉旁的地毯上。
words.en: A rug is a piece of thick material that you put on the floor to cover part of it and to make it warmer or softer to walk on.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.ex: He is taking a bath in the bathtub.
words.ex_cn: 他正在浴缸里洗澡。
words.en: A bathtub is a long, usually rectangular container which you fill with water and sit in to wash your body.

words.tr: n. 固定物；固定装置；固定成员
words.ex: The shelf is a fixture in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 这个架子是厨房里的固定物。
words.en: A fixture is a piece of equipment or furniture which is fixed in position in a building or vehicle.

words.tr: n. 家具陈设；室内陈设品；
words.ex: The room has simple furnishings.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有简单的家具陈设。
words.en: The articles of furniture and other items that are used to make a room or building suitable for living or working in.

words.tr: phrase. 个人财物；私人财产；随身物品
words.ex: He lost his personal possessions in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中丢失了个人物品。
words.en: Personal possessions are things that belong to a particular person and are considered as their own property.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.tr: 短语动词. 为个人财物购买保险
words.ex: He got insurance for personal possessions after his bike was stolen.
words.ex_cn: 他的自行车被偷后，他为个人物品买了保险。
words.en: To obtain a policy that provides financial protection for one's personal belongings against loss, theft, or damage.

words.ex: The children threw garbage on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔在地上。
words.en: Waste material; unwanted or undesired material.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.ex: He disposed of the old books.
words.ex_cn: 他处理了那些旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something means to get rid of it, especially by throwing it away.

words.tr: phrase. 煤气表；燃气计量表
words.ex: The man read the gas meter yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这个人昨天读了燃气表。
words.en: A device that measures the volume of gas used in a building, typically to calculate the cost.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那只昆虫飞过了草地。
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.ex: The burglar broke into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: A burglar is a person who illegally enters buildings and steals things.

words.tr: n. 漏泄，耗散 v. 漏( leak的现在分词 ); 渗入，漏出; 使泄露
words.ex: The roof is leaking in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨时屋顶在漏水。
words.en: The act of allowing liquid or gas to escape from a container or system, often unintentionally.

words.ex: The pipe has a small leakage.
words.ex_cn: 这条管道有一个小泄漏。
words.en: The accidental escape or entry of a substance or radiation through a hole or crack.

words.tr: phrase. 丢失的钥匙；遗失的钥匙
words.ex: He lost his key and couldn't enter the house.
words.ex_cn: 他弄丢了钥匙，进不了家门。
words.en: A key that has been misplaced or cannot be found.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；（使）逐渐适用
words.ex: Thieves broke in through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从后门闯入。
words.en: To enter a building by force, especially in order to steal something; to interrupt a conversation or activity.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
